entries.title: Aurora Links 3D
entries.description: A complete single-file WebGL golf game with a nine-hole tournament, four-club bag, wind and wet-weather physics, night floodlights, glowing LED balls, green reading and a playable course designer. Call your score before you play the hole and the scorecard tracks that prediction separately from your strokes, so a brave, accurate call can rescue an untidy hole. Build your own in the Course Lab and play it.

entries.title: Axiom Shift
entries.description: A one-button rhythm runner where the beat is something you see, not hear — a visible pulse you read instead of music, so it plays in a silent classroom and works for a deaf pupil. Four forms with genuinely different physics (jump, gravity-invert, hold-to-fly, flap), six geometric Propositions, a date-seeded Daily Shift that's the same run for the whole class offline, and the opt-in Axiom Rule for the purists. You never lose — a touch smudges and rewinds to the last checkpoint, and your furthest progress is always kept. Offline, no accounts, no sound.
